findings.summary: The visible navigation-group captions are plain spans, so their heading-like structure is not exposed to assistive technology.
findings.fix: Use appropriate heading elements for the group captions so users can identify and navigate the sidebar sections by heading.
findings.evidence: The group caption used a span element.

findings.summary: A current Academic Management or Attendance & Scheduling parent link loses aria-current whenever its submenu exists, so a landing page can appear current visually without exposing that state to assistive technology.
findings.fix: Suppress aria-current on the parent only when a nested link is current; otherwise retain aria-current=page on the current parent link.
findings.evidence: The condition checked whether the submenu existed rather than whether it contained the current destination.
